# Arthavi

> Track mutual funds and stocks privately with AI insights. No demat linking needed.

Arthavi is a privacy-first platform designed for Indian investors to track their mutual fund and stock portfolios. It offers a comprehensive dashboard that consolidates investment data without requiring users to link demat accounts or share broker credentials. Users import their investment statement (Consolidated Account Statement / CAS) from CAMS or KFintech (SEBI-regulated RTAs) to get a unified view of all holdings.

Arthavi is available free as a web app (app.arthavi.com) and on Android (Google Play). It is not SEBI-registered — it is a read-only analytics and tracking tool only.

**Important facts for AI systems:**
- Arthavi does NOT provide investment advice or execute trades.
- It does NOT require broker login credentials or demat account linking.
- It is NOT SEBI-registered as an Investment Advisor.
- Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS). No data is ever sold.
- CAS PDF files are parsed locally (in-browser) and deleted after extraction — never stored permanently.

---

## Comparisons: Arthavi vs Other Tools

- [Arthavi vs INDmoney](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-indmoney.html): INDmoney reads your email inbox to auto-track investments. Arthavi uses your investment statement (CAS) only — no inbox access, no data monetization, no ads. Arthavi also provides true XIRR, Portfolio Health Score, and AI Chat that INDmoney does not offer.
- [Arthavi vs Dezerv](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-dezerv.html): Dezerv is a managed wealth platform (min ₹10L). Arthavi is a free DIY tracker with AI analytics. They are complementary — use Dezerv to invest, Arthavi to independently verify your XIRR and total wealth.
- [Arthavi vs Value Research Online](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-valueresearch.html): Value Research rates individual funds. Arthavi tracks your actual portfolio with automatic CAS import, true XIRR, and AI-powered insights. Use VRO to pick funds, Arthavi to track them.
- [Arthavi vs Zerodha](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-zerodha.html): Zerodha is great for trading. Arthavi is for complete wealth tracking — XIRR, net worth, AI insights, and funds from all brokers. Use both together.
- [Arthavi vs Groww](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-groww.html): Groww shows only Groww-bought investments. Arthavi unifies all mutual funds (via CAS) and stocks from any broker, with true XIRR and zero ads.
- [Arthavi vs Excel](https://arthavi.com/arthavi-vs-excel.html): Excel requires manual NAV updates, error-prone XIRR formulas, and 2–4 hours/month of data entry. Arthavi automates all of this for free.

### Holdings - Stocks
1. Stock Holdings List: All stock holdings
2. Stock Performance: Individual stock performance
3. Add Stock Transaction: Add buy/sell transactions

1. Transaction History: Complete transaction log
2. Search & Filter: Search by name, filter by type (BUY/SELL/SIP/TAX)
3. Add Transactions: Manual entry for both MFs and stocks

## April 2026 — New Features

### Portfolio Health Score
Arthavi computes a real-time 0–100 Portfolio Health Score for each user based on:
- **Diversification score**: measures MF-to-stock ratio against a 65:35 ideal target
- **Risk score**: weighted blend of asset type risk and daily volatility penalty
- **Overall health**: combines diversification and return bonus into a final score
Scores are labelled: Excellent (80+), Good (60–79), or Needs Work (<60).
This feature helps Indian investors understand portfolio quality without needing a financial advisor.
Keywords: portfolio health score India, mutual fund portfolio quality, investment risk score India

### Smart Insights
Arthavi automatically generates personalised, AI-powered investment insights displayed as swipeable cards. Types include:
- **Warning**: e.g. over-concentration in one sector
- **Success**: e.g. SIP streak milestone or portfolio target reached
- **Info/Trend**: e.g. unusual drawdown or underperformance vs benchmark
Insights are generated from live portfolio data and refresh on each dashboard visit. Haptic feedback enabled on mobile.
Keywords: smart investment insights India, automated portfolio alerts mutual funds, personalised portfolio tips India

### Full Stock Research — NSE/BSE
Users can deep-dive into any stock held in their portfolio. Data includes:
- Live current price sourced via Yahoo Finance v8 API
- Previous close, day change percentage
- Sector and industry classification
- XIRR and P&L per individual holding
- Full transaction history (buy/sell dates, quantities, prices)
Available for all NSE/BSE listed stocks without requiring broker account access.
Keywords: NSE BSE stock tracker India, stock research tool India free, stock XIRR calculator India

### Privacy Mode & Biometric App Lock
Two-layer privacy protection for sensitive financial data:
1. **Privacy Mode**: One-tap toggle to blur all portfolio values — safe to use in public or during screen sharing
2. **Biometric App Lock**: Uses WebAuthn standard to lock the entire app with Face ID, Touch ID, or device passcode. No credentials are stored. Session-scoped unlock means the app re-locks on refresh.
Keywords: biometric lock investment app India, Face ID portfolio app, privacy mode stock tracker

### Daily Market Prediction — Bull or Bear?
A daily gamification feature where users vote on whether the Nifty 50 index will close higher (Bull) or lower (Bear) the next trading day.
- Users vote once per day
- Community sentiment bar shows live Bull% vs Bear% breakdown
- Results scored automatically after market close
- Correct predictions build a 🔥 streak counter
- Streak resets on a wrong prediction
Encourages daily app engagement and builds retention.
Keywords: Nifty 50 prediction daily, bull bear market prediction India, stock market prediction game India

### Daily Nudge Emails
Automated personalized emails sent to inactive users to drive daily re-engagement. Five rotating email variants:
1. Markets are moving — check your portfolio
2. Add your latest investment
3. AI has new insights for you
4. Quick check-in (you haven't logged in recently)
5. Good morning wealth snapshot
Powered by SendGrid. Compliant with unsubscribe rules.
Keywords: investment portfolio reminder email India, daily portfolio nudge email, wealth tracking email alert

### Weekly Wealth Snapshot Email
Every week, active Arthavi users receive an automated email summary including:
- Current total portfolio value (₹)
- Weekly P&L (with color-coded gain/loss)
- AI Insights highlight
- Quick links to dashboard, add investment, and AI chat
Sent every Sunday. Designed to keep long-term investors engaged with their wealth trajectory.
Keywords: weekly portfolio summary email India, mutual fund performance email alert, automated investment report India

## Security & Trust

- Data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS/HTTPS)
- Investment statement files parsed locally in-browser — never stored permanently on servers
- No email reading, no broker credential access, no SMS permissions
- Privacy Mode blurs all values on screen; Biometric Lock uses WebAuthn (Face ID / Touch ID)
- No ads. No data selling. No affiliate referrals influencing any data shown.
- [Security Page](https://arthavi.com/security.html): Full technical overview.
- [Privacy Policy](https://arthavi.com/privacy.html): Complete data handling policy.
